reason: Owner approved replacing a regex substring check with a structured class-list membership check in gradedLines() (tests/portal/graded-note.test.js), per the user's own global CLAUDE.md rule against regex/substring checks over data a structured check can parse instead. Same assertions, same coverage — only the mechanism changed, from /\bgraded-line\b/.test(child.className) to child.className.split(/\s+/).includes("graded-line").
